fr_html: L'observation de M. de Lapradelle sur le droit des juges nationaux de motiver leur dissentiment dans la sentence, doit être réservée pour la séance où l'on s'occupera de la motivation des jugements.
en_html: M. de Lapradelle's remark concerning the right of national judges to have the reasons of their dissent recorded in the judgment, should be brought up for discussion at the meeting at which the question of including a statement of reasons in the judgment would be considered.
